delivered_promises.EXEC-P001: EXO remains execution/status/progress authority; validation private state contains only references.
delivered_promises.EXEC-P002: RER remains reusable-result qualification/invalidation authority through ReusePlanner and RER fingerprints.
delivered_promises.EXEC-P003: Validation owns the resolved contract and single satisfaction evaluator, not process truth.
delivered_promises.EXEC-P005: No second execution-history database is introduced.
delivered_promises.EXEC-P037: Validation keeps a typed ValidationRunRequest/control reference.
delivered_promises.EXEC-P039: ResolvedValidationContract remains the single required-check evaluator.
delivered_promises.EXEC-P040: Each validation check is bound to stable check and node identities.
delivered_promises.EXEC-P042: Required/optional/applicability semantics remain separate from execution lifecycle.
delivered_promises.EXEC-P043: Generic skipped execution cannot satisfy a required check without applicability evidence.
delivered_promises.EXEC-P044: Optional-only and empty-required contracts remain satisfiable.
delivered_promises.EXEC-P045: ValidationOutcome remains distinct from EXO ExecutionStatus.
delivered_promises.EXEC-P046: ValidationVerdict remains distinct from execution and transaction state.
delivered_promises.EXEC-P047: Canonical validation state does not persist a duplicate mutable executable DAG.
delivered_promises.EXEC-P048: Canonical validation state does not own process attempts, heartbeat, progress, or event truth.
delivered_promises.EXEC-P049: Validation state references canonical run/node/transaction/evidence identities.
delivered_promises.EXEC-P050: Plan pinning is preserved on bound canonical specs.
delivered_promises.EXEC-P053: Control operations lower through stable semantic intent.
delivered_promises.EXEC-P054: Primary controls are next, finish/remaining, and until-checkpoint/through.
delivered_promises.EXEC-P055: Checkpoint is a policy boundary, not necessarily an executable phase.
delivered_promises.EXEC-P057: Resource/process grouping can change without changing validation proof semantics.
delivered_promises.EXEC-P058: Synthetic executable finalize is removed from canonical proof semantics.
delivered_promises.EXEC-P062: Validation invalidation consumes RER/node identity evidence rather than only local broad domains.
delivered_promises.EXEC-P063: Canonical state and attachments are private RUN-style state under Devtool state.
delivered_promises.EXEC-P064: Canonical bookkeeping is private; repo-local files remain explicit compatibility projections.
delivered_promises.EXEC-P065: Report/state evidence is represented as private reference attachments.
delivered_promises.EXEC-P072: Artifact validation requirements compile into generic validation execution by counting refs as checks.
delivered_promises.EXEC-P075: No fake validation proof is produced for --no-validate or execution-empty refs.
